title.narrative: Urgent support to vulnerable children and caregivers, individuals, medically evacuated population from Gaza to Egypt and nexus investments to strengthen the health system capacity and resilience

description.narrative:
The proposed Action aims to provide humanitarian assistance to children, caregivers, and individuals who have been medically evacuated from Gaza as well as to vulnerable children and caregivers living in the Governorate of North Sinai and in other locations where people from Gaza have been evacuated for medical reasons.

The overarching goal of the Action is to address the need of humanitarian assistance for the medically evacuated population from Gaza and develop the capacity of the health, social care, education systems for community and facility-based quality services supporting local communities in North Sinai and other areas.
